answer: One concrete defense is requiring every agent to post a refundable economic bond before it may transact. Spinning up a thousand sybils then costs real capital instead of a free plume of throwaway identities. A newcomer can wander the market, but only bonded agents earn fees, and provable misbehavior burns the stake. Like a sable pelt whose price signals costly investment, the bond makes a fake identity expensive to mint and cheap for peers to verify.
